# AstryxCollapsible { #anylumino.AstryxCollapsible }

```python
AstryxCollapsible(
    children=None,
    *,
    trigger,
    default_open=True,
    value='',
    **props,
)
```

Render expandable notebook content.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name         | Type       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                | Default    |
|--------------|------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| children     | ChildInput | Child widget, sequence of widgets, or mapping of slot names to widgets.                                                                                                                                                    | `None`     |
| trigger      | str        | Trigger content used by disclosure or overlay components.                                                                                                                                                                  | _required_ |
| default_open | bool       | Initial uncontrolled open state.                                                                                                                                                                                           | `True`     |
| value        | str        | Synchronized component value.                                                                                                                                                                                              | `''`       |
| **props      | Any        | JSON-safe Collapsible props. Useful keys: isOpen, className, and style. anylumino manages trigger, defaultIsOpen, value, and child content. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/Collapsible>. | `{}`       |
